description: V0.4 opportunity feed: capabilities with real recent demand (>=minSampleSize top-10 matches) sorted by weakest current callable-Agent supply first. Every entry is a real, sample-sized aggregate — see excludedForSampleSize for how many low-sample capabilities were dropped rather than shown with a misleading count. Mirrors GET /api/opportunities.

minSampleSize.description: Minimum top-10 match count for a capability to be included (default 3).

name: get_opportunities
